t: Sheyakol lomar qeriat shema beal peh
s: Sheyakol lomar qeriat shema beal peh ubo seip echad: nahagu liqrot parashat haqqorbanot veken shear pesuqim, kegon zemirot veshirat hayyam uqeriat shema vekayyotze bazeh, hakkol beal peh. Veap al pi sheameru chaza"l: debarim shebbiktab i atta rashshay leomram beal peh, mikkol maqom kol dabar shehu shagur veragil bepi hakkol kegon ellu sheamarnu — muttar. Abal im lo shagur bepi hakkol ap al pi sheshshagur bepiv — asur. Veyesh omerim shettaam hamminhag hu, shello aseru lomar debarim shebbiktab beal peh ella sheomer kede lehotzi acherim yede chobatam (abal kol echad leatzmo — muttar. Veyesh lizzaher kassebara harishona. Abal hammeqel kassebara haacharona — en tzarik limchot beyado). Vesuma muttar liqrot beal peh ledibre hakkol, mishshum "et laasot laHashem heperu torateka":
